versions.name: Everything grew
versions.summary: v0.3 rebuilt the codebase. v0.4 is what got built on top of it: a sidebar, a real dock, clips, karaoke, a new overview, colour that reaches every app, and a shell that sets itself up and updates itself.

highlights.title: A new overview
highlights.text: Your workspaces in one card, HUD cards in the corners, Alt+Tab and search inside the grid, and a window inspector.

highlights.title: A sidebar and a real dock
highlights.text: A second edge full of small modules, and a dock with live previews and jump lists.

highlights.title: Clips
highlights.text: A replay buffer: save the last minutes of a game with one key, then trim it in the built-in editor.

highlights.title: Colour everywhere
highlights.text: A colour wave, a palette per workspace or from the album playing, and apps that repaint live.

highlights.title: Karaoke
highlights.text: Sing along to synced lyrics and get ranked from SS to F.

highlights.title: Ask the shell
highlights.text: An AI that can change your colours and settings, running on your own machine by default.

sections.title: Overview
items: Rebuilt in the panels' look: a header with search, your workspaces in one card, HUD cards in the corners
Only busy workspaces get a cell — tap Shift for all ten, and an empty one waits as "+ New workspace"
Alt+Tab and window search live inside the grid; search understands ws:, app: and is:
Right-click a window to inspect it: live preview, float, pin, fullscreen, send, close
Ctrl+click selects several windows to move as one, and Ctrl+Z undoes a move
Hold Space over a window to see it big without going there
A left face you swipe: these notes, an AI that changes the shell, and the news
Opens by zooming out of the workspace you're on, and zooms into the one you pick

sections.title: Bar and panels
items: Panels weld into the bar as one shape; the optional blob plugin melts them together
Wallpaper, colours, the mixer and updates rebuilt to one recipe, and they hug their content
An entrance when the shell starts or reloads, and pills that animate their changes
The volume and brightness sliders grow out of the screen frame
Cookie shapes drift behind panels, the bar and the frame, picked from your wallpaper
A new power menu

sections.title: Sidebar and dock
items: A sidebar on the dock edge: stats, clips, timer, colour picker, clipboard, notifications, screen time, Lens, voice and power
Every module can sit on the bar or the sidebar — drag them where you want
Side panels open off the sidebar, one at a time
A real dock: pinned and running apps, live previews, jump lists, SUPER+ALT+number to launch
Dock styles, magnification, and auto-hide with reveal rules
Idle actions: after a while without input, lock, turn the screen off, suspend or run your own command

sections.title: Clips and capture
items: A ShadowPlay-style replay buffer on gpu-screen-recorder: save the last stretch with one key
Record the whole screen or a region; trim and export in the built-in editor
A clip library with a player, bulk actions, and drag-out into any app
Game names on clips, presets, storage limits, and a diagnosis when recording won't start
Screenshots get a toast with an annotator, plus a snip tool
Lens reads and translates any text on screen
A magnifier

sections.title: Music
items: A now-playing panel with word-synced lyrics from Spicy, LRCLIB and NetEase
Lyrics can be translated and romanized, syllable by syllable
Karaoke: sing to the lyrics, get an osu!-style rank, keep your best scores
Music recognition tells you what's playing around you
Volume profiles for Spotify, up to 135%

sections.title: Colour and theme
items: A new colour washes across the screen as a wave
Each workspace can have its own wallpaper and colour scheme
Colours can follow the album cover of what's playing
Open apps repaint live: the terminal, GTK and Qt apps, Discord, Spotify, Dark Reader, even the cursor
A light theme with tinted pages
No colours yet? They're read from your wallpaper — the shell never wears a built-in scheme
Icon shapes and corner styles to choose from

sections.title: Notifications
items: A notification centre with search, by-app and by-day views, selection and undo
Do Not Disturb for a while, mute an app, snooze, copy and reply
It sits beside your workspaces in the overview

sections.title: Launcher
items: Run commands, calculate, convert units and search the web
Ask an AI with ? — Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Grok, or a model on your own machine
Install packages from the repos or the AUR with +
Shell actions: lock, reload, open any panel

sections.title: Everyday tools
items: Night light, an anti-flashbang filter and screen time
Snap zones for floating windows
Timers with focus sessions, alarms that snooze and repeat, and laps
A to-do list, and a random panel: coin, wheel, roulette
Optional sound effects, including key sounds
The shell's own password prompt, and secrets kept in the keyring
A warning on the power menu when ending the session would interrupt something
Battery saver: the ambient effects rest while you're on battery
SUPER+L locks, and the screen locks before the machine sleeps

sections.title: Apps and games
items: Discord: a call bar and a voice panel, plus rich presence for Claude Code and CS2
Claude sessions: resume a recent one and watch your rate limits
Bluetooth pairing from the shell
A HUD for games: FPS cap, performance and your keys on screen, pinned over fullscreen

sections.title: Setup and updates
items: A welcome panel and Settings › Setup find what's missing and install it, asking for your password once
Quicktest updates itself: signed releases, one click, no password
The update panel follows each phase of a system update
Setup spots a second bar, notification daemon or password agent and tells you how to drop it
A smaller core install; Clips, Game Mode and the rest are packs you tick in Setup

sections.title: Settings
items: Every page redesigned, with previews and help tips
Search across all settings, and undo
The bar is its own module picker, and the desktop is the widgets page
Displays: arrange your screens, set mode, scale, rotation and VRR, and get 15 seconds to undo a bad one
Mouse and touchpad: speed, acceleration, natural scrolling, tap to click

sections.title: Under the hood
items: Icons ship with the shell, so a font upgrade can't redraw them as something else
Idle surfaces rest, and the overview's backdrop costs half what it did
Hyprland events instead of polling, wherever there's an event
Static checks, a smoke test and CI guard every change
Ready for translations

versions.name: The refactor
versions.summary: A full-codebase rebuild. Config format, directory layout and most of the QML changed since v0.2.

sections.title: Added
items: A Settings app: bar, wallpaper, widgets, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, sound, battery, storage, updates, keyboard, language, Hyprland, about
The overview: a full-screen workspace grid, dock, now playing with synced lyrics, calendar, clipboard, timers, power
A built-in notification daemon, replacing dunst and swaync
17 draggable desktop widgets
A bar layout editor with presets, and a colour scheme editor
Wallpaper Engine support, and a native Hyprland config editor
Speed test, mic test, word-synced lyrics

sections.title: Changed
items: Colour overrides persist across wallpaper changes
Volume, network and the mixer run on native services instead of polling
One shared audio spectrum instead of up to three cava processes
The dock groups one icon per app

sections.title: Performance
items: Event-driven instead of polling, wherever the API allows
Background work runs only while something uses it
Popups and panels load when opened
